questions.question: Which operation is typically INSTANT in MySQL 8.0/8.4?
options: Changing a column from INT to BIGINT
questions.explanation: Adding a column only changes the data dictionary. Changing a column data type requires COPY.

questions.question: Why specify ALGORITHM and LOCK explicitly in a migration?
options: It makes the ALTER run faster
MySQL refuses instead of silently falling back to a slower, blocking method
questions.explanation: If the requested algorithm is not supported, MySQL returns an error rather than quietly choosing a slower approach.

questions.question: Why can a millisecond-long instant ALTER freeze an application?
options: It waits for a metadata lock held by a long transaction, and new queries queue behind it
It always blocks writes for an hour
questions.explanation: The ALTER needs a brief exclusive metadata lock; while it waits, all new queries on the table queue behind it. A short lock_wait_timeout makes it fail fast.

questions.question: How does gh-ost capture ongoing writes to the original table?
options: By running the ALTER on replicas only
questions.explanation: gh-ost reads row-format binary logs, avoiding triggers; pt-online-schema-change uses triggers.
